purpose: Machine-readable catalog for host-owned modern settings. Runtime/source remains authoritative until each descriptor is generated from this catalog.

versioning_policy.current: Versions 1-5 remain strict by version and exact field set. Version 6 has a required administrative core plus known additive keys whose absence receives typed defaults; unknown keys remain rejected.
versioning_policy.target: Keep Version 6 as the stable additive envelope: extend the known-key set and typed defaults when optional settings are added, and reserve schema changes for grammar or compatibility changes.
versioning_policy.rule: Do not bump the host-state version solely because a new optional setting exists unless the encoded grammar or compatibility contract actually changes.
